question.text: If an electron of hydrogen atom moves from fourth excited state to ground state in Lymen series find the total number of spectral lines?

solution.text: Total number of spectral lines <math><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>5</mn><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>5</mn><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mn>10</mn></math>
